text.translation: Braving the unknown.

text.translation: Defeating demons.

text.reference: そなた…「人間」にしては{n}なかなかよい目をしておる{n}よかろう何なりと申すがよい
text.translation: You... for a human,{n}there is something admirable in your gaze.{n}Very well. Say what you will.

text.reference: 何を欲しておるのだ
text.translation: What is it you desire?

text.reference: いきなり本題か…{WAIT}{n}まぁそう急ぐことはない{n}もう少しそなたを知ってからだ
text.translation: Straight to the matter, are we...?{WAIT}{n}There is no need for such haste.{n}First, I would know you better.

text.reference: ほう{BEAT}これはこれは{BEAT}{n}おもしろいことを申すのだな…
text.translation: Oh?{BEAT} Well, well.{BEAT}{n}What an intriguing thing to say...

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}何をたわけたことを申すのだ{n}まぁ若いうちはそれでよいのだが
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}What foolishness is this?{n}Still, such is the privilege of youth...

text.reference: 強気なのだな…{n}他の者ならそれも通用するのかもしれぬな{WAIT}{n}そんなことよりもだ
text.translation: Bold words...{n}They may serve you against lesser folk.{WAIT}{n}More importantly...
text.note: Fragment context: message 103 deliberately trails into the following negotiation branch after "More importantly..."

text.reference: そなたのしていることは{n}盗賊も同じこと{n}あまり感心できぬな
text.translation: What you do{n}differs little from thievery.{n}I cannot commend it.

text.reference: そなた達は我らの持てるものまで{n}欲しているというのか{BEAT}{n}嘆かわしいものよ
text.translation: You would take even{n}what we possess?{BEAT}{n}How lamentable.

text.reference: ちょうどよい{n}我が方からもそなたに話があるのだ
text.translation: Just as well.{n}I, too, have something to discuss with you.

text.reference: 悪いが聞いている暇はない{n}そもそも{n}我らは相対しているのだぞ
text.translation: Regrettably, I have no time to listen.{n}We stand opposed to one another,{n}after all.

text.reference: 我が望みは{n}そなたとの勝負なり{n}そのような望み聞く耳もたぬ
text.translation: My desire is{n}to cross blades with you.{n}I have no ear for such a request.

text.reference: 何を申すかと思えば…{WAIT}{n}はっはっはっ{n}我が力をよほどおそれていると見える
text.translation: And here I wondered what you would say...{WAIT}{n}Ha ha ha!{n}You must fear my power greatly.

text.reference: ほうおもしろい{n}こんな所で「人間」にお目にかかるとはな
text.translation: How curious.{n}To encounter a human in a place such as this...

text.reference: いったい何故ここにおる
text.translation: What brings you here?

text.reference: 「日々これ鍛練なり」{BEAT}{n}武道の心を理解しているということか
text.translation: "Each day is training."{BEAT}{n}So you understand the spirit of the martial path?

text.reference: それはよい心がけ{n}これからも精進いたせ
text.translation: A worthy attitude.{n}Continue to devote yourself.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}修行だと{WAIT}笑わせてくれる{n}千年早いが…
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}Training, you say?{WAIT} You amuse me.{n}You are a thousand years too soon...

text.reference: 感心感心{n}なかなか誠をつくしているようだな
text.translation: Admirable, admirable.{n}You seem to pursue your duty in earnest.

text.reference: 仕事{WAIT}おお生業のことか{n}生業とはいえそなたの行動は{n}合点がいかぬ
text.translation: Work?{WAIT} Ah, your livelihood.{n}Even so, I cannot make sense{n}of your conduct.

text.reference: 平和か…{BEAT}なつかしい響きよのう{WAIT}{n}それよりそなた自身のことはどうなのだ
text.translation: Peace...{BEAT} What a nostalgic word.{WAIT}{n}But what of you yourself?

text.reference: そんなことを考えておるのか{n}ふっ甘い甘い
text.translation: So that is what occupies your thoughts?{n}Hmph. Naive--far too naive.

text.reference: なるほど{n}まずは「人間」のことから{n}始めようという訳だな
text.translation: I see.{n}You mean to begin{n}with the human folk.

text.reference: ほう「人間」以外の存在も{n}この街にはたしかにあるのだぞ{n}それでよいのか
text.translation: There are surely beings other than humans{n}in this city.{n}Will that suffice?

text.reference: 人々のためだと{WAIT}{n}結局そういうことか{n}しょせんは人の子という訳か
text.translation: For the people, you say?{WAIT}{n}So that is what it comes to.{n}You are a child of man after all.

text.reference: 血迷うた手合いかと思えば{n}「人間」にあやつられておるのか
text.translation: I took you for a madman,{n}but are humans merely pulling your strings?

text.reference: いったい何用だ
text.translation: What business have you?

text.reference: 悪魔をあまり困らせるものではない{n}もう少し話題を選んで{n}話してもらわんとな
text.translation: One should not trouble demons so.{n}You must choose a better subject{n}if you wish me to converse.

text.reference: それはできぬな{n}否できぬというよりしてはならぬのだ{n}しかしながら
text.translation: That cannot be done.{n}Nay, it must not be done.{n}However...
text.note: Fragment context: message 125 ends with "However..." before the following negotiation branch supplies the contrast.

text.reference: いきなりそれでは無礼であろう{n}そのような振る舞いをして{n}暮らしを立てているのか
text.translation: Such haste is discourteous.{n}Is this how you conduct yourself{n}and earn your living?

text.reference: 無茶なことを…{WAIT}{n}我らは「悪魔」だぞ{n}分かっていて申しておるのか
text.translation: What an absurd request...{WAIT}{n}We are demons, you know.{n}Do you grasp what you are asking?

text.reference: 下がれこの痴れ者めが{n}これだから「人間」はたちが悪い
text.translation: Stand back, you witless fool.{n}This is why humans cannot be trusted.

text.reference: よかろう申すがよい{n}予想はついておる「人間」のことであろう
text.translation: Very well. Speak.{n}I can guess already: this concerns humans.

text.reference: 応じる悪魔も出てくるだろう{n}すべてはそなたの心がけ次第だ
text.translation: Some demons may oblige you.{n}All depends upon how you comport yourself.

text.reference: またにしてもらおう{n}そんな状況ではあるまい
text.translation: Another time.{n}These are hardly the circumstances for it.

text.reference: そんな言葉で{n}我らをどうにかしようというのか{n}ふん片腹痛いわ
text.translation: You think mere words{n}will bring us to heel?{n}Hmph. Laughable.

text.reference: ほんとうに去ってよいのか{n}そなたの方が困るのではないかな
text.translation: Are you certain you wish me to go?{n}I suspect you would be the one inconvenienced.

text.reference: 断じてことわる{n}まったく何を考えておるのだ
text.translation: I categorically refuse.{n}What in the world are you thinking?

text.reference: ここは我ら悪魔の領域のはず
text.translation: This should be the domain of demons.

text.reference: 何故ここにおるのだ
text.translation: Why are you here?

text.reference: 心がけだけは感心できるのだが{n}今のそなたではな…
text.translation: Your resolve alone is commendable,{n}but as you are now...
text.note: Cross-record context: message 137 leaves the hero's present inadequacy unstated; message 138 (dialogue_0138) supplies the advice to keep training.

text.reference: せいぜい精進することだ{n}我らを目指すがよい
text.translation: Train as diligently as you can.{n}Strive to reach our heights.
text.note: Cross-record context: message 138 supplies the advice prompted by message 137 (dialogue_0137).

text.reference: 仕事だと{n}もっと「人間」らしいことをすれば{n}よいであろう{WAIT}しかもだ
text.translation: Work, you say?{n}You ought to pursue{n}something more human.{WAIT} Moreover...
text.note: Fragment context: message 139 ends with "Moreover..." and message 140 supplies the added criticism.

text.reference: こんな所にまで現れるとは{n}まともな仕事ではないのであろうが
text.translation: To come even here...{n}Hardly respectable work, I imagine.
text.note: Fragment context: message 140 completes message 139: the work is both inhuman and, since it brought the hero here, disreputable.

text.reference: 平和だと{n}そなたがもたらしているのは{n}混乱にすぎないではないか
text.translation: Peace?{n}You bring{n}naught but chaos.

text.reference: 平和だとそなたの口から{n}そんな言葉を聞くことができるとはな
text.translation: Peace? To think I would hear{n}such a word from your lips.

text.reference: 我らのことは{n}どうなっても知らぬという訳か
text.translation: And what becomes of us{n}matters not to you?

text.reference: そうではあるまい{n}結局自分を満足させたいだけのこと{n}ならば戦うこともあるまいが
text.translation: Surely not.{n}In the end, you seek only your own satisfaction.{n}If so, there is no cause for us to fight.

text.reference: やはりそう答えたか{n}我らとは相いれぬ存在{n}それも分かっていたこと
text.translation: As I thought, that is your answer.{n}Our kinds cannot coexist.{n}That too I already knew.

text.reference: それで我らと{n}一戦交えたいのかっ
text.translation: And so you would{n}do battle with us?!

text.reference: 「人間」ふぜいと言葉を交わすなど{n}悪魔の名おれだが
text.translation: To exchange words with a mere human{n}shames the name of demon, yet...
text.note: Cross-record context: message 147 concedes that talking is disgraceful; message 148 (dialogue_0148) nevertheless asks the hero to state his business.

text.reference: とにかく用向きを申してみよ
text.translation: Nevertheless, state your business.
text.note: Cross-record context: message 148 resolves the concession in message 147 (dialogue_0147): despite the disgrace, the demon will listen.

text.reference: 愚かなことを{n}そのようなことを言うために{n}うろついているのか
text.translation: How foolish.{n}Is that why{n}you wander about?

text.reference: 自分の口にした言葉の意味を{n}理解しているとは思えぬな
text.translation: I doubt you comprehend{n}the meaning of your own words.

text.reference: そのような用向きに{n}つきあっている暇などないわ{n}愚か者め
text.translation: I have no time{n}to indulge such business.{n}Fool.

text.reference: 哀れなものよ{n}そこまでおちぶれていようとは
text.translation: How pitiful.{n}To think you had fallen so low.

text.reference: 「人間」とは「物乞い」を意味する{n}言葉だったとはな
text.translation: "Human" must be another word{n}for "beggar."

text.reference: 話だと{BEAT}我らにか{WAIT}{n}どうせたかがしれているのであろう
text.translation: You wish to talk?{BEAT} With us?{WAIT}{n}I doubt you have anything of consequence to say.

text.reference: そなたのつまらぬ話など{n}聞くに及ばぬが
text.translation: I need not listen{n}to your tedious prattle, but...

text.reference: 悪魔を意のままにできると{n}うぬぼれているようだな{n}ふん気に入らぬ
text.translation: You seem vain enough to believe{n}you can bend demons to your will.{n}Hmph. I dislike that.

text.reference: よかろう{n}ただし{WAIT}{n}そなた達を始末してからだがな
text.translation: Very well.{n}But only{WAIT}{n}after I have disposed of you.

text.reference: ここをどこだと心得ておる{n}そなたたちをどうするも{n}我らの思うがままなのだぞ
text.translation: Do you know where you stand?{n}What becomes of you{n}is ours to decide.

text.reference: 何故迷いこんだ
text.translation: Why did you stray in here?

text.reference: さすればさらなる精進が必要であろう{n}そなたの力など赤子も同然
text.translation: Then you require further discipline.{n}Your strength is that of an infant.

text.reference: ならば遠慮なく{n}相手をしよう
text.translation: Then I shall face you{n}without restraint.

text.reference: 仕事だと{WAIT}{n}それは名目にすぎぬのではないか{n}しょせん目当ては金であろうが
text.translation: Work?{WAIT}{n}That is merely a pretext, is it not?{n}In the end, money is all you seek.

text.reference: そんなもの忘れてしまえ{n}何をやっても徒労に終わるのだからな
text.translation: Forget such a thing.{n}Whatever you attempt shall end in vain.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}これは愉快なことを{n}そなたに何ができよう
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}What an amusing notion.{n}What could you possibly accomplish?

text.reference: ここで黄泉へ旅立つことが{n}平和への道だとは思わぬか{n}おとなしくここへ直れ
text.translation: Do you not think departing for Yomi here{n}would best serve the cause of peace?{n}Now submit quietly.

text.reference: そこまでして{n}守らねばならぬものなのか{n}我には分からぬが
text.translation: Is it truly something{n}that must be protected at such cost?{n}I cannot understand it.

text.reference: 人々のためにとな{n}されば我らが敵ということになるな
text.translation: For the sake of the people?{n}Then we are enemies.

text.reference: おっとまだ名を申していなかったな{n}我は{demon_name}と申す
text.translation: Ah, I have yet to give my name.{n}I am called {demon_name}.

text.reference: してそなたの名は
text.translation: And what is your name?

text.reference: …………{WAIT}{n}本当のことは言えぬのだな{n}まぁよい名を知らずとも話はできる
text.translation: ............{WAIT}{n}You cannot speak the truth, then.{n}Very well. We may converse without names.

text.reference: その名よく知っておるぞ{n}そなたちといたずらがすぎるようだな
text.translation: I know that name well.{n}You and yours have been causing far too much mischief.

text.reference: 聞いていた名とは違うな{n}「人間」は自分の都合ですぐ嘘をつく{WAIT}{n}…まあよい{BEAT}よく聞け
text.translation: That is not the name I heard.{n}Humans lie whenever it suits them.{WAIT}{n}...Very well.{BEAT} Listen closely.

text.reference: 偽りを申すでない{n}我らをだます気かっ
text.translation: Speak no falsehood.{n}Would you deceive us?!

text.reference: それぞれにそれぞれの道があり{n}また重きを置いているものも違う
text.translation: Each has a path of his own,{n}and each esteems different things.

text.reference: そなたはどうだやはり「誠」か
text.translation: And you? Is sincerity what you esteem?

text.reference: やはりそうであろう{n}うむ大いに結構
text.translation: As I expected.{n}Mm. Most commendable.

text.reference: 口だけは達者だな{n}我にはそうは思えぬな
text.translation: You speak well enough.{n}I cannot say I believe you.

text.reference: ふむその心確かなのだな{WAIT}{n}そういう信念なら
text.translation: Hm. Your conviction is firm, then.{WAIT}{n}If that faith is true...
text.note: Fragment context: message 178 leaves "If that conviction is true..." open for the following negotiation outcome.

text.reference: 甘いな{n}はっはっはっ
text.translation: How naive.{n}Ha ha ha!

text.reference: だから愚かだと言うのだ
text.translation: That is precisely why I call you a fool.

text.reference: そなたよほどの大物かただの馬鹿か{n}よく分からぬな
text.translation: I cannot tell whether you are a great personage{n}or merely an utter fool.

text.reference: 「謙虚」という言葉があるであろう{n}こういうときは少しは遠慮するものぞ
text.translation: There is a word: "humility."{n}At times such as this, one ought to show some restraint.

text.reference: もっと「勉強」が必要ではないのか
text.translation: Do you not require more "study"?

text.reference: よし分かっておるようだな{n}ついでと言ってはなんだが少々話がある
text.translation: Good. You seem to understand.{n}While we are here, there is a small matter I would discuss.

text.reference: 最低の礼儀は心得ておるようだな{n}それなら話しておきたいことがある
text.translation: You appear to know the barest courtesy.{n}Then there is something I would tell you.

text.reference: 好意を無にしおって{n}かならず後悔する日が来るぞ
text.translation: You spurn my goodwill.{n}The day shall surely come when you regret it.

text.reference: 無礼者{WAIT}まったくもって話にならぬわ
text.translation: Insolent wretch!{WAIT} There is no reasoning with you.

text.reference: 我が道をゆくか…{n}それもよかろう
text.translation: You walk your own path...{n}Very well.

text.reference: それがそなたの答えか
text.translation: That is your answer?

text.reference: 目上の者に接するときは{n}礼節を守るのも大切なことだぞ
text.translation: When addressing your elders,{n}proper decorum is important.

text.reference: それくらい分かるであろう
text.translation: Surely you understand that much.

text.reference: やっと素直になったな{n}話を続けるとするか
text.translation: At last, you are being honest.{n}Let us continue.

text.reference: やけに素直だな気味が悪いぞ
text.translation: You are suddenly quite obedient. It is unsettling.

text.reference: やっと理解できたようだな{n}実は聞いておきたいことがあるのだ
text.translation: At last you seem to understand.{n}In truth, there is something I would ask.

text.reference: 返事だけはよいようだな{n}調子のよい奴め
text.translation: Your answer is agreeable, at least.{n}What a glib fellow.

text.reference: なんだその口のききかたは
text.translation: What manner of speech is that?

text.reference: まともに聞いておるのか{n}そのような態度許せぬ
text.translation: Are you listening to me at all?{n}I shall not tolerate such conduct.

text.reference: 頭の中のからくりを{n}調べてもらった方がよいようだな{n}まさか分からぬとは…
text.translation: You ought to have the workings of your mind{n}examined.{n}To think you truly do not understand...

text.reference: 返事はそれか{n}あきれてものも言えぬわ
text.translation: That is your answer?{n}I am too appalled for words.

text.reference: ひっこれはこれはご無礼を{n}それほどまでの力量の持ち主とは…{WAIT}{n}今の一言で気付きましたぞ
text.translation: Oh! Well, well--forgive my discourtesy.{n}To think you possessed such ability...{WAIT}{n}Your last remark opened my eyes.

text.reference: 強気に言っても無駄だぞ{n}そんなことで動じたりせぬわ
text.translation: Bluster will avail you nothing.{n}I shall not be shaken by that.

text.reference: いったいそなたはどういう{n}つもりなのだ
text.translation: Just what are you{n}trying to accomplish?

text.reference: どんな生業をしておる
text.translation: What is your profession?

text.reference: 「探偵」だとふむ「忍」のことを{n}そう申すのか{n}まっとうな「忍」となるためにも
text.translation: "A detective"? Hm. Is that what you call{n}a shinobi?{n}To become a proper shinobi...
text.note: Fragment context: message 204 intentionally trails off after "To become a proper shinobi..." before the response branch.

text.reference: そのようなよく分からぬ生業{n}聞いたこともない
text.translation: I have never heard{n}of such an incomprehensible trade.

text.reference: さほど楽しいものではあるまい
text.translation: It cannot be very enjoyable.

text.reference: そっ{BEAT}それではそなたが…{WAIT}{n}もしそなたが{n}まことの{kyouji_name}なら…
text.translation: Th-{BEAT}then you are...?{WAIT}{n}If you are truly{n}{kyouji_name}...
text.note: Fragment context: message 207 conditionally identifies the inserted title and leaves its consequence to the following branch.

text.reference: 聞いているぞそなたの噂{n}さればここで成敗してくれよう
text.translation: I have heard tell of you.{n}Then I shall punish you here and now.

text.reference: いつもその調子でいられると思うなよ{n}気にさわる奴め
text.translation: Do not imagine you can always behave so.{n}You are an irksome one.

text.reference: 答えぬならそれでもよい{n}ここまでにするだけのこと
text.translation: If you will not answer, so be it.{n}Our conversation ends here.

text.reference: いずれにせよそんなことが{n}楽しいとは思えぬがな
text.translation: In any case, I cannot imagine{n}such work being enjoyable.

text.reference: そのような生業で満足しているのか
text.translation: Are you satisfied with such a profession?

text.reference: それが本音なのか{BEAT}{n}どうあっても「人間」が大事だという訳か
text.translation: Is that your true belief?{BEAT}{n}So humans matter to you above all else?

text.reference: 満足だと{BEAT}骨まで腐った奴だな
text.translation: Satisfied?{BEAT} You are rotten to the very bone.

text.reference: 言い訳など聞くに及ばぬ
text.translation: I have no need of excuses.

text.reference: ほんとうにそれでよいのか{n}もう少し真剣に考えてみよ
text.translation: Are you truly content with that?{n}Think upon it more seriously.

text.reference: 好きにするがよい{n}誰も止めはせぬ
text.translation: Do as you please.{n}No one shall stop you.

text.reference: 芯のない奴め{n}我が力でたたき直してやるわ
text.translation: Spineless wretch.{n}I shall hammer some mettle into you.

text.reference: そうまで言うならどうだ{n}ここでひとつ腕試しをしてみぬか
text.translation: If you insist, then...{n}Shall we test your skill here and now?

text.reference: いかなる勝負でも受けてたつぞ
text.translation: I shall accept any contest.

text.reference: 見事{BEAT}{n}そなたの心澄んでいるようだな
text.translation: Splendid.{BEAT}{n}Your heart appears unclouded.

text.reference: なんだそのへっぴり腰は{n}修行がたりぬ
text.translation: What is that craven stance?{n}You lack discipline.

text.reference: そなた速いな{n}かわすのがやっとであったぞ{n}「心」のなせる技という訳か
text.translation: You are swift.{n}I barely evaded you.{n}So this is the art born of "spirit"?

text.reference: 遅い遅い{n}今度はこちらから行かせてもらうぞ
text.translation: Too slow, too slow!{n}Now I shall make my move.

text.reference: そなたの母上でべそ…{WAIT}ええいやめだ{n}分かった分かった負けを認めよう
text.translation: Your mother has an outie...{WAIT} Bah, enough!{n}Very well, very well. I concede defeat.

text.reference: たいした神経の持ち主だ{n}子供でももう少しまともな{n}勝負を挑んでくるぞ
text.translation: You have remarkable nerve.{n}Even a child would propose{n}a worthier contest.

text.reference: くっやるな{n}そこまでの腕っぷしとは{n}そなたの心迷いがないな
text.translation: Ghh... Well done.{n}I did not expect such strength.{n}Your heart is free of doubt.

text.reference: 無駄だ無駄だ{n}ふっ{BEAT}{n}なんだそれが持てる力のすべてか
text.translation: Useless, useless!{n}Hmph.{BEAT}{n}Is that truly all the strength you possess?

text.reference: そこまで言うなら{n}ここでそなたの運を試してやろう
text.translation: If you insist,{n}I shall test your fortune here.

text.reference: 小判を投げるゆえ表か裏かを当てるのだ
text.translation: I shall toss a koban coin. Call heads or tails.

text.reference: 見事{WAIT}「表」だ{n}精神力と言いたいのであろう
text.translation: Splendid.{WAIT} Heads it is.{n}You would call that strength of mind, I suppose.

text.reference: 見事{WAIT}…と言いたいところだが裏だ{n}残念だったな
text.translation: Splendid...{WAIT} is what I would like to say,{n}but it is tails. A pity.

text.reference: ふむ{WAIT}裏が出てしもうたか{n}いさぎよく負けを認めよう{n}たいした集中力だ
text.translation: Hm...{WAIT} Tails has come up.{n}I shall concede defeat with good grace.{n}A remarkable power of concentration.

text.reference: ふむ{WAIT}表が出たぞ{n}哀れこんなことでも勝てぬのか{BEAT}{n}くだらぬ勝負をしてしもうた
text.translation: Hm...{WAIT} Heads it is.{n}Pitiful. You cannot win even at this?{BEAT}{n}What a foolish contest that was.

text.reference: そなたのようになりたくないものよのう{n}ふん仕方がない
text.translation: I should hate to become like you.{n}Hmph. Very well.

text.reference: なにを恵んで欲しいのだ
text.translation: What would you have me bestow upon you?

text.reference: ほんとうにあきれた奴だ{n}そんなに欲しいならくれてやる{n}{offered_item}といったところであろう
text.translation: You truly are beyond belief.{n}If you desire it so badly, I shall give it to you.{n}{offered_item} should suffice.

text.reference: かかったな{offered_item}くれてやる{n}抱えたままで死ぬがよい
text.translation: You fell for it. I shall give you {offered_item}.{n}Die clutching it to your breast.

text.reference: 本気で手に入ると思うたのか{n}この愚か者め
text.translation: Did you truly believe you would receive it?{n}Fool.

text.reference: {offered_item}くれてやる{n}ただしそのまま冥土へ行くことになるがな
text.translation: I shall give you {offered_item}.{n}Though you shall carry it straight to the land of the dead.

text.reference: 考えてやるとするか…{WAIT}{n}ふむ{offered_item}でも{n}持ってゆくがよい
text.translation: Let me consider...{WAIT}{n}Hm. You may take{n}{offered_item}.

text.reference: 本気にしたか{WAIT}ふふそうあっさりと{n}くれてやる訳にはゆかぬ{BEAT}残念だったな
text.translation: You believed me?{WAIT} Heh. I cannot{n}part with it so readily.{BEAT} A pity.

text.reference: そなたそんなことでよいのか
text.translation: Are you truly content to be thus?

text.reference: まだ見込みは残っているようだな…{WAIT}{n}よかろう話しに応じよう
text.translation: There may yet be hope for you...{WAIT}{n}Very well. I shall hear you out.

text.reference: そうかならばそれでよい{n}そなたとの話もこれまでだ
text.translation: I see. Then so be it.{n}Our conversation is at an end.

text.reference: そなたのようには{n}我ら悪魔は落ちることができぬのう{BEAT}{n}ひとつ教えてはもらえぬか
text.translation: We demons could never sink{n}to your depths.{BEAT}{n}Would you teach me one thing?
text.note: Cross-record context: message 246 asks for instruction; message 247 specifies the sarcastic question, how to become so debased.

text.reference: どうすればそうまでになれるのだ
text.translation: How does one fall so low?
text.note: Cross-record context: message 247 supplies the question introduced by message 246.

text.reference: 答えることはできまい{WAIT}{n}自分を見直すよい機会になったであろう
text.translation: You cannot answer, can you?{WAIT}{n}Consider this a fine chance to reflect upon yourself.

text.reference: 何も言えぬのか{BEAT}そうであろうな
text.translation: You have nothing to say?{BEAT} I thought as much.

text.reference: こっ{BEAT}これは失礼した{WAIT}{n}いやはや男ならそうこなくては…
text.translation: Th-{BEAT}that was discourteous of me.{WAIT}{n}Indeed, that is how a man ought to respond...

text.reference: 急に強気になっても無駄だぞ{n}そなたがどれほどのものなのか{n}分かっているのだからな
text.translation: Sudden bluster will avail you nothing.{n}I know precisely{n}what you are worth.

text.reference: そこまで言い切れるとは{n}もしや…{BEAT}ものすごく大物なのでは…
text.translation: To speak with such certainty...{n}Could it be...?{BEAT} Are you a personage of tremendous stature...?

text.reference: やはりそうか{WAIT}{n}そなたそれでよいのか
text.translation: So it is true?{WAIT}{n}Are you content with yourself?

text.reference: やはりそうか{WAIT}{n}分かっていたことだがな
text.translation: As I thought.{WAIT}{n}I knew it already.

text.reference: 話というのはほかでもない{n}最近の街の様子はどうも騒がしい
text.translation: The matter is this:{n}the city has been strangely unsettled of late.

text.reference: いったいどうなっているのだ
text.translation: What in the world is happening?

text.reference: 何を言う{n}我ら悪魔は無関係だ
text.translation: What are you saying?{n}We demons have nothing to do with it.

text.reference: 何か根拠があって申しておるのか{n}納得できぬなそのような言葉は
text.translation: Have you grounds for that claim?{n}I cannot accept such words.

text.reference: やはりそうなのか…
text.translation: So it is true...

text.reference: やはりな{WAIT}{n}我ら悪魔の手で成敗するしかないか…{BEAT}{n}手始めにそなたから始末するとしよう
text.translation: As I thought.{WAIT}{n}Then we demons must punish the culprit ourselves...{BEAT}{n}I shall begin by disposing of you.

text.reference: ふむ急いだ方がよい
text.translation: Hm. You had best make haste.

text.reference: そなたの力で本当に調べられるのか{BEAT}{n}せいぜいがんばることだ
text.translation: Can one of your ability truly investigate this?{BEAT}{n}Do your utmost, at least.

text.reference: 我らが心配することでは{n}ないのかもしれぬが…
text.translation: It may not be a matter{n}for us to worry over, but...

text.reference: この街に何か異変はないか
text.translation: Have there been any strange occurrences in this city?

text.reference: 無理をするでないぞ
text.translation: Do not overexert yourself.

text.reference: そなたにどれほどのことができるか…{WAIT}{n}期待しておるぞ
text.translation: How much can one such as you accomplish...?{WAIT}{n}I expect results.

text.reference: 確かにそなたの言う通りだが…{BEAT}{n}我らの気持ちも察してくれ心配なのだ
text.translation: You are correct, to be sure...{BEAT}{n}But consider our feelings. We are concerned.

text.reference: 我ら悪魔が考えることではないとな
text.translation: You say it is no concern of demons.

text.reference: 我ら悪魔には分からぬ
text.translation: We demons cannot fathom it.

text.reference: 残念だが分からぬのだ
text.translation: Regrettably, I do not know.

text.reference: ここで試しに手合せをしてみては{WAIT}{n}悪くはあるまい
text.translation: A trial bout here{WAIT}{n}would not be amiss.

text.reference: では参るぞ
text.translation: Then I come!

text.reference: ほう{BEAT}なかなかやるな{n}…ふっ精神力か…
text.translation: Oh?{BEAT} You are rather capable.{n}...Hmph. Strength of mind, is it...?

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}その程度か{BEAT}精進いたせ
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}Is that all?{BEAT} You must train harder.

text.reference: くっ{BEAT}まさか押し負けるとは{n}…ふっ精神力か…
text.translation: Ghh...{BEAT} To think I would be overpowered.{n}...Hmph. Strength of mind, is it...?

text.reference: 我が力思い知ったか{WAIT}{n}はっはっはっ
text.translation: Now do you comprehend my strength?{WAIT}{n}Ha ha ha!

text.reference: まっ{BEAT}まいった
text.translation: I-{BEAT}I yield.

text.reference: 無駄だ無駄だ{WAIT}ほれっ
text.translation: Useless, useless!{WAIT} There!

text.reference: 男子たるものあらゆることで{n}自分を磨くそれも大切なことだぞ
text.translation: A man must polish himself{n}in every art. That too is important.

text.reference: 何なりと教えてやるぞ
text.translation: I shall teach you whatever you desire.

text.reference: よしそれでは目を閉じよ{WAIT}{n}精神を落ちつけて…{WAIT}{n}なんだ寝てしまったか
text.translation: Good. Now close your eyes.{WAIT}{n}Calm your spirit...{WAIT}{n}What is this? Have you fallen asleep?

text.reference: よしそれでは目を閉じよ{WAIT}{n}精神を落ちつけて…{WAIT}{n}今だ
text.translation: Good. Now close your eyes.{WAIT}{n}Calm your spirit...{WAIT}{n}Now!

text.reference: そのようなこと…{BEAT}{n}いくらなんでも勘弁してくれ
text.translation: Such a thing...?{BEAT}{n}No. Even I must beg you to spare me that.

text.reference: そういった発想が愚かだと言うのだ
text.translation: It is that very manner of thinking I call foolish.

text.reference: ではかかってこい
text.translation: Then come at me.

text.reference: ………まいった{n}…ふっ精神力か…
text.translation: ......... I yield.{n}...Hmph. Strength of mind, is it...?

text.reference: ………だめだだめだ{n}出直してこい
text.translation: ......... No, no.{n}Return when you are ready.

text.reference: 特に家族のことが心配なのであろう
text.translation: You are especially concerned for your family, are you not?

text.reference: そなたの家族は安全に暮らしているのか
text.translation: Does your family live in safety?

text.reference: すまぬ悪いことを聞いてしまったな
text.translation: Forgive me. I should not have asked.

text.reference: そうなのか{n}そなたも家庭を持てば{n}成長するかもしれぬのにな
text.translation: Is that so?{n}Perhaps if you started a family,{n}you too might mature.

text.reference: なかなか人の情というものも{n}捨てたものでもないようだな
text.translation: It seems human affection{n}is not wholly without merit.

text.reference: 心がけは感心するが{n}この街ではちと甘すぎるのう
text.translation: Your intentions are commendable,{n}but far too naive for this city.

text.reference: なんだその言い方は{BEAT}{n}親兄弟を大切にせぬ奴は早死にするぞ
text.translation: What manner of answer is that?{BEAT}{n}Those who neglect kith and kin die young.

text.reference: くっ救われぬ奴{n}我が手で引導を渡してやる
text.translation: Ghh... You are beyond salvation.{n}I shall deliver your last rites myself.

text.reference: それほどまでに「人間」を大事にするなら{n}家庭を持って平穏に暮らせばよいのに
text.translation: If humans matter so much to you,{n}why not start a family and live in peace?

text.reference: 家庭に興味はないのか
text.translation: Have you no interest in having a family?

text.reference: だから成長せぬのだ
text.translation: That is why you never mature.

text.reference: そういう生き方がよいと思っておるのも{n}今のうちだけだぞ
text.translation: You will believe such a life is best{n}only while you are young.

text.reference: これは失礼した{n}そなたにも事情があるのであろうな…
text.translation: Forgive me.{n}You must have circumstances of your own...

text.reference: ならば即刻立ち去るがよい{n}そして平穏に暮らすのだ
text.translation: Then leave this place at once{n}and live in peace.

text.reference: ふんつまらぬ{BEAT}{n}つまらぬわ
text.translation: Hmph. Tedious.{BEAT}{n}Utterly tedious.

text.reference: 何かおもしろいことはないのか
text.translation: Is there nothing diverting to be found?

text.reference: 行けばおもしろいことがあると言うのだな{BEAT}{n}ふむよかろう行動を共にしよう
text.translation: You say amusement awaits if I go with you?{BEAT}{n}Hm. Very well. I shall accompany you.
text.note: Fragment context: message 304 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0305) with the demon's inserted race and name.

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}かならずやそなたの期待に応えようぞ
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I shall not fail your expectations.
text.note: Fragment context: message 304 page 1 completes page 0 (dialogue_0304); message 445 page 1 likewise follows its recruitment line.

text.reference: 行けばおもしろいことがあると言うのだな{BEAT}{n}ふむそうは思えぬがな
text.translation: You say amusement awaits if I go with you?{BEAT}{n}Hm. I think not.

text.reference: ふむそうさせてもらうとしよう
text.translation: Hm. Then I shall do so.

text.reference: なにをいきなり…{BEAT}{n}もうよいわ
text.translation: What is this so suddenly...?{BEAT}{n}Enough.

text.reference: 分かった分かった{n}もうよい
text.translation: I understand, I understand.{n}That is enough.

text.reference: これしきのこと…{BEAT}{n}こちらで勝手に楽しませてもらうとするか
text.translation: This paltry affair...?{BEAT}{n}I shall find my own amusement.

text.reference: しかしながらそなたの言うこと{n}考えてやらぬこともないぞ
text.translation: Nevertheless, I may yet{n}consider what you propose.

text.reference: そのかわり何かやってもらおうか
text.translation: In return, perhaps you shall perform some feat for me.

text.reference: 見事な技だ{n}そこまでの腕ならあるいは…{WAIT}{n}そなたを見とどけるとしよう
text.translation: A splendid technique.{n}With skill such as that, perhaps...{WAIT}{n}I shall see where your path leads.
text.note: Fragment context: message 312 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0314) with the demon's inserted race and name.

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}かならずやそなたの期待に応えようぞ
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I shall not fail your expectations.
text.note: Fragment context: message 312 page 1 completes page 0 (dialogue_0313).

text.reference: 見事な技だが…{n}そんなものをみせられてもな
text.translation: A splendid technique, but...{n}what good is showing it to me?

text.reference: つまらぬ{n}そんなもので満足すると思うてか
text.translation: Tedious.{n}Did you think that would satisfy me?

text.reference: ひっ{BEAT}なんだ{n}その飛び道具は{WAIT}{n}いやはや感服いたしました…
text.translation: Ah!{BEAT} What{n}is that projectile weapon?{WAIT}{n}I am deeply impressed...
text.note: Fragment context: message 315 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0318) with the demon's inserted race and name.

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}そなたの期待に応えますぞ
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I shall meet your expectations.
text.note: Fragment context: message 315 page 1 completes page 0 (dialogue_0317).

text.reference: 奇怪な技をつかいおって{n}ええい{BEAT}成敗してくれる
text.translation: You employ some bizarre art.{n}Enough!{BEAT} I shall punish you.

text.reference: ほうそんな芸当ができるのか{n}なかなかのものだったぞ{n}よし{offered_item}をくれてやろう
text.translation: Oh? You can perform such a feat?{n}That was rather impressive.{n}Very well. I shall give you {offered_item}.

text.reference: ほうそんな芸当ができるのか{n}なかなかのものだったぞ
text.translation: Oh? You can perform such a feat?{n}That was rather impressive.

text.reference: そのままひとりで遊んでおれ
text.translation: Continue playing by yourself.

text.reference: くっいまいましい奴め{n}そなたのことなど知らぬわ
text.translation: Ghh, you accursed wretch.{n}I want nothing more to do with you.

text.reference: そなたには分かるまい{n}いったい何が大切なのかがな
text.translation: You could never understand{n}what truly matters.

text.reference: それでも分かると言い張るのか
text.translation: And still you insist that you understand?

text.reference: だまっていても何も始まらぬのだぞ
text.translation: Silence shall accomplish nothing.

text.reference: ふっ答えられまい{n}そなたの人生まだまだ修行が必要だな
text.translation: Hmph. You cannot answer.{n}Your life requires much further discipline.

text.reference: まだそのようなことを言っているのか…
text.translation: You still speak such nonsense...?

text.reference: これ以上話しても平行線のまま{n}交わることもあるまい
text.translation: If we speak further, our paths shall remain parallel.{n}They shall never meet.

text.reference: 迷いそして行動するのだ{n}さすれば道は開ける
text.translation: Doubt, then act.{n}Thus shall the path open before you.

text.reference: では身をもって知るがよい{n}これも修行ぞ
text.translation: Then learn through your own flesh.{n}This too is training.

text.reference: そのような考えで{n}我が前にその身をさらすなど
text.translation: To expose yourself before me{n}while harboring such thoughts...
text.note: Cross-record context: message 329 trails into message 330 (dialogue_0333), which asks whether the hero has no pride.

text.reference: そなたにはプライドがないのか
text.translation: Have you no pride?
text.note: Cross-record context: message 330 completes the rebuke begun by message 329 (dialogue_0332).

text.reference: さればその身で示してみよ{BEAT}{n}どこからでもかかってこい
text.translation: Then prove it with your body.{BEAT}{n}Come at me from wherever you please.

text.reference: そうは見えぬがな{n}せいぜいがんばるがよい{BEAT}{n}気を付けてな{WAIT}…さらばだ
text.translation: It does not appear so to me.{n}Do your utmost, at least.{BEAT}{n}Take care.{WAIT} ...Farewell.

text.reference: 待っておったぞその言葉{n}そうでなくてはいかん
text.translation: I have awaited those words.{n}That is as it should be.
text.note: Fragment context: message 333 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0337), where the demon accepts negotiations.

text.reference: よかろう{BEAT}{n}そなたとの交渉に応じよう
text.translation: Very well.{BEAT}{n}I shall negotiate with you.
text.note: Fragment context: message 333 page 1 completes page 0 (dialogue_0336).

text.reference: ほう威勢がよいな{n}まぁせいぜい努力することだ
text.translation: Oh? Such spirit.{n}Strive as best you can.

text.reference: 馬鹿なのか大物なのか{BEAT}{n}まぁどちらでもよいのだが
text.translation: Whether you are a fool or a great personage...{BEAT}{n}Well, either will do.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}ついに開き直ったか
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}So at last you have grown defiant.

text.reference: よし決心がついたぞ
text.translation: Good. My mind is made up.

text.reference: 我が力を振るうのもよかろう
text.translation: I suppose I may lend my strength.

text.reference: うむ
text.translation: Indeed.

text.reference: うむ分かった{WAIT}{n}そなたの心がけ次第だがな…
text.translation: Mm. Understood.{WAIT}{n}Though it shall depend upon your conduct...

text.reference: そうかそれは残念だ{n}ならばそのかわりに{n}{offered_item}を贈ろう
text.translation: I see. That is regrettable.{n}Then in its stead,{n}I shall give you {offered_item}.

text.reference: そうかそれでは仕方がないな
text.translation: I see. Then it cannot be helped.

text.reference: そうかそれは残念だ{n}また縁があったら助力しよう
text.translation: I see. That is regrettable.{n}Should fate bring us together again, I shall aid you.

text.reference: なんだいらぬと言うのか
text.translation: What? You say you have no need of it?

text.reference: その心おそれ入った
text.translation: I am humbled by your resolve.

text.reference: 我にできることはないか
text.translation: Is there aught I can do for you?

text.reference: よかろうただし条件次第だがな
text.translation: Very well, though it shall depend upon the terms.

text.reference: そうか仕方がないな
text.translation: I see. Then it cannot be helped.

text.reference: 好意は素直に受けるものだぞ…{BEAT}{n}もうよい好きにするがよい
text.translation: One ought to accept goodwill graciously...{BEAT}{n}Enough. Do as you please.

text.reference: 我も悪魔のことのみを{n}考えている訳ではないのだ
text.translation: It is not as though I think{n}only of demonkind.

text.reference: そなたと契りを結ぶことも可能だが
text.translation: A pact between us may be possible, but...
text.note: Cross-record context: message 351 raises the possibility of a pact; the following negotiation branch determines whether it is accepted.

text.reference: うむよかろう{n}それではと{BEAT}そうだな…
text.translation: Mm. Very well.{n}Then...{BEAT} yes, let us see...
text.note: Cross-record context: message 352 accepts the pact raised in message 351 (dialogue_0355) and trails into the selected condition.

text.reference: うむよかろう{n}では盃を持て{WAIT}{n}くっくっ…{BEAT}飲みほしたな
text.translation: Mm. Very well.{n}Then take up the cup.{WAIT}{n}Heh heh...{BEAT} You drank it all.

text.reference: くっ最後までふてぶてしい奴め
text.translation: Ghh... Insolent to the very end.

text.reference: そのような態度をとるのか…{WAIT}{n}気が変わった{n}今の話なかったことにしてもらおう
text.translation: So that is your attitude...?{WAIT}{n}I have changed my mind.{n}Forget that offer.

text.reference: 分かったもう何も言うまい{n}正々堂々と勝負いたそう{BEAT}{n}かかってこい
text.translation: Very well. I shall say no more.{n}Let us contest this honorably.{BEAT}{n}Come at me.

text.reference: そういう強がりが不幸をまねくのだ{n}まだ分からぬのかこの状況が
text.translation: Such bravado invites misfortune.{n}Do you still not understand your predicament?

text.reference: 我らの間にはまだまだ壁がある{WAIT}{n}乗り越える方法があるとすれば{n}ただひとつ
text.translation: A wall yet stands between us.{WAIT}{n}If there is one way to surmount it,{n}it is this...
text.note: Cross-record context: message 358 introduces the one way to cross the wall; message 359 (dialogue_0363) proposes that the hero serve the demon.

text.reference: そなたが我に従うというのはどうかな
text.translation: What say you to serving me?
text.note: Cross-record context: message 359 supplies the solution introduced by message 358 (dialogue_0362).

text.reference: そうであろうな…{BEAT}{n}それが我とそなたとの運命だからな
text.translation: I thought as much...{BEAT}{n}Such is the fate between you and me.

text.reference: 努力をおしみおって{n}体で覚えるがよい
text.translation: You begrudge the effort.{n}Then learn it with your body.

text.reference: よしそなたと行動を共にしよう{WAIT}{n}我は{race}{demon_name}{n}しかと我に従うのだぞ
text.translation: Good. I shall accompany you.{WAIT}{n}I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}See that you obey me faithfully.

text.reference: ではこの盃を飲みほせ{n}さあ早く{WAIT}{n}どうだうまいであろう
text.translation: Then drain this cup.{n}Quickly now.{WAIT}{n}Well? Delicious, is it not?

text.reference: ではこの盃を飲みほせ{n}さあ早く{WAIT}{n}かかったな
text.translation: Then drain this cup.{n}Quickly now.{WAIT}{n}You fell for it.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}からかってみたまでよ{n}なかなか愉快であったぞ
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}I merely wished to tease you.{n}That was most amusing.

text.reference: しかしながらほんとうに情けない奴だな{n}そなたのような従者はいらぬ
text.translation: Nevertheless, you truly are pathetic.{n}I have no need of a servant such as you.

text.reference: もうよい{WAIT}{n}そなたの好きにするがよいわ
text.translation: Enough.{WAIT}{n}Do as you please.

text.reference: せいぜい用心することだ分かったな
text.translation: Exercise the greatest caution. Is that understood?

text.reference: くっ生意気なやつめ{WAIT}{n}…心づかいは感謝しておこう
text.translation: Ghh... Impudent wretch.{WAIT}{n}...Still, I thank you for your concern.

text.reference: くっ生意気なやつめ{WAIT}{n}…二度と顔を見せるな
text.translation: Ghh... Impudent wretch.{WAIT}{n}...Never show your face before me again.

text.reference: それでよいのだそれで
text.translation: That is well. Just so.

text.reference: 最初からそうやって{n}素直になっていればよかったものを
text.translation: Had you been so obedient{n}from the outset, all would have been well.

text.reference: 口のへらぬ奴め{n}二度と現れるなよ
text.translation: Insolent to the last.{n}Never appear before me again.

text.reference: 口のへらぬ奴め{n}安心せよ我が手で冥土へ送ってやる
text.translation: Insolent to the last.{n}Fear not. I shall send you to the grave myself.

text.reference: ひっ{n}なっ{BEAT}なめてなどおらぬ…{BEAT}おりませぬ{n}何とぞお許しを…
text.translation: Ah!{n}I-{BEAT}I do not underestimate you...{BEAT} I assure you, I do not.{n}Please forgive me...

text.reference: なめているのはそなたの方だ{n}永遠の眠りにつくがよい
text.translation: It is you who underestimate me.{n}Sleep forevermore.

text.reference: もうよい{WAIT}{n}これ以上は何も申すまい
text.translation: Enough.{WAIT}{n}I shall say nothing further.

text.reference: ただその調子でいられると思うなよ
text.translation: But do not imagine you may continue in this fashion.

text.reference: ほんとうに分かっておるのか{n}まだまだ困難は続くのだぞ
text.translation: Do you truly understand?{n}Many trials still await.

text.reference: おお理解したようだな{n}さっそくだが{n}その調子でいられぬこと証明してみせよう
text.translation: Oh, so you understand.{n}Then without delay,{n}I shall prove you cannot maintain that attitude.

text.reference: うむ{n}その気持ち忘れるでないぞ
text.translation: Mm.{n}Do not forget that feeling.

text.reference: ふん{n}どうせ口先だけであろうが
text.translation: Hmph.{n}It is all empty words, I suspect.

text.reference: これほど申しても分からぬかっ
text.translation: You still do not understand after all I have said?!

text.reference: ひっ{BEAT}{n}調子に乗っているのは我が方でした{n}何とぞお許しを
text.translation: Ah!{BEAT}{n}It was I who became carried away.{n}Please forgive me.

text.reference: そなたと関っていると{n}不愉快だ
text.translation: Dealing with you{n}is unpleasant.

text.reference: いったい何が楽しいと言うのだ
text.translation: What exactly do you find enjoyable?

text.reference: そうであったか{n}ならば考えてやらぬでもない{n}そなたの気持ち次第だがな
text.translation: Is that so?{n}Then I may yet consider it.{n}It depends upon your sincerity.

text.reference: 交流を望むなら{n}もう少し気を付けることだ{WAIT}{n}覚えておくがよい
text.translation: If you seek communion,{n}you must show greater care.{WAIT}{n}Remember that.

text.reference: なるほどそうか…{BEAT}{n}この場はこれでおさめよう{WAIT}{n}ゆくがよい
text.translation: I see...{BEAT}{n}We shall leave matters here.{WAIT}{n}You may go.

text.reference: ならばその挑戦受けよう{n}我も「未知なるもの」なのだからな
text.translation: Then I accept your challenge.{n}For I, too, am an "unknown."

text.reference: どうした{BEAT}答えられぬのか{n}それは自分の意志を持たぬからだぞ
text.translation: What is wrong?{BEAT} Can you not answer?{n}It is because you lack a will of your own.

text.reference: どうした{BEAT}早く答えぬか{WAIT}{n}ふっもうよいわ
text.translation: What is wrong?{BEAT} Answer me at once.{WAIT}{n}Hmph. Enough.

text.reference: もう何も申すまい{WAIT}{n}楽しいだと悪魔を殺すことがか…
text.translation: I shall say no more.{WAIT}{n}Enjoyable, you say? Is slaying demons enjoyable...?

text.reference: 何を言う{n}倒されるのはそなたの方だ
text.translation: What nonsense.{n}You are the one who shall fall.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}そなたにできるものか{n}どこからでもかかってこい
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}As though you were capable of it.{n}Come at me from wherever you please.

text.reference: ひっ{BEAT}{n}なっ何を言う{WAIT}いやおっしゃる{n}それだけはお許しを…
text.translation: Ah!{BEAT}{n}Wh-what are you saying?{WAIT} I mean, what are you saying, my lord?{n}Anything but that...

text.reference: そなたと関っていると{n}こちらまで調子が狂うてしまう
text.translation: Dealing with you{n}puts even me ill at ease.

text.reference: そろそろ行くぞ
text.translation: It is time I departed.

text.reference: ならぬ{WAIT}と言ったら{n}どうするつもりだったのだ{n}甘いぞその考え
text.translation: Suppose I had said no.{WAIT}{n}What did you intend to do?{n}How naive.

text.reference: ならぬ{WAIT}{n}ここで楽になるがよい
text.translation: No.{WAIT}{n}Find your peace here in death.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}これは愉快その程度の力でか
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}How amusing. With strength such as yours?

text.reference: ならば遠慮なくゆかせてもらうぞ
text.translation: Then I shall depart without hesitation.

text.reference: そなたのことはよく分かった
text.translation: I understand you well now.

text.reference: いいから通してもらおう
text.translation: Enough. Let me pass.

text.reference: うむそれでよいのだ{n}{offered_item}でもくれてやる{n}なあにほんの通行料がわりだ
text.translation: Mm. That is as it should be.{n}I shall even give you {offered_item}.{n}Consider it a mere toll.

text.reference: ならば立ち去れ{n}おめおめと逃げ出すがよい
text.translation: Then begone.{n}Flee in disgrace.

text.reference: ふん言われるまでもないわ
text.translation: Hmph. I need no urging.

text.reference: おっとその前にと{BEAT}{n}そなたを始末するのを忘れておった{WAIT}{n}ゆくぞ
text.translation: Ah, but first...{BEAT}{n}I nearly forgot to dispose of you.{WAIT}{n}Have at you!

text.reference: ならば倒してでも進むまで{n}そなたの方からかかってくるがよい
text.translation: Then I shall defeat you and proceed.{n}You may make the first move.

text.reference: ならば倒してでも進むまで{n}こちらからゆかせてもらうぞ
text.translation: Then I shall defeat you and proceed.{n}I shall make the first move.

text.reference: そう言われてもな…{WAIT}{n}困った奴だが仕方がない{n}もう少し相手をしてやるとするか
text.translation: Even if you say so...{WAIT}{n}You are troublesome, but very well.{n}I shall indulge you a little longer.

text.reference: 自分の立場と言うものが{n}まだ分かっていないようだな{n}ならば倒して進むまでのこと
text.translation: You still seem not to comprehend{n}your own position.{n}Then I need only defeat you and proceed.

text.reference: 今までの悪行わびてもらおう
text.translation: You shall answer for your past misdeeds.

text.reference: 分かればよいのだ分かればな
text.translation: So long as you understand. Yes, so long as you do.

text.reference: 本当だな{n}ならば水に流してやろう
text.translation: You speak truly?{n}Then I shall let bygones be bygones.

text.reference: ほう{BEAT}ならば死んでもらおう
text.translation: Oh?{BEAT} Then you shall die.

text.reference: ほうそうきたか{n}そなたとはもう二度と話すまい
text.translation: Oh? So that is your answer.{n}I shall never speak with you again.

text.reference: ほうそうきたか{n}ならば「死」あるのみ
text.translation: Oh? So that is your answer.{n}Then only death remains.

text.reference: {OP:8025}こうしょうすたーと{OP:8020}
text.translation: {OP:8025}NEGOTIATION START{OP:8020}

text.reference: まずは…
text.translation: First...
text.note: Cross-record context: message 421 opens the demand completed by message 422 (dialogue_0425): "First... I shall have {requested_item}."

text.reference: {requested_item}をいただこうか
text.translation: I shall have {requested_item}.
text.note: Cross-record context: message 422 completes the opening in message 421 (dialogue_0424): "First... I shall have {requested_item}."

text.reference: なんだ持っておらぬではないか{n}仕方のない奴だな{n}それでは…
text.translation: What? You do not possess it.{n}What a hopeless fellow.{n}Then...
text.note: Cross-record context: message 423 ends with "Then..." and message 424 (dialogue_0427) supplies the fallback.

text.reference: またの機会ということにいたそう
text.translation: We shall leave it for another occasion.
text.note: Cross-record context: message 424 completes the fallback introduced by message 423 (dialogue_0426).

text.reference: せっかくだがそれぐらいではな{WAIT}{n}どうしたものか…
text.translation: A kind offer, but that alone will not suffice.{WAIT}{n}What am I to do...?

text.reference: くっ仕方がない{n}それでは…
text.translation: Ghh... It cannot be helped.{n}Then...

text.reference: ふざけるな{n}どうやら無駄だったようだな
text.translation: Do not trifle with me.{n}It appears this was futile.

text.reference: ともあれ何かいただこうかな
text.translation: In any case, I shall take something.

text.reference: ……………{WAIT}{n}黙っていると思うたら{n}何ひとつ持っていないのか…
text.translation: .............{WAIT}{n}I wondered why you were silent.{n}Do you possess nothing at all...?

text.reference: その程度ではな…
text.translation: That paltry amount will not do...
text.note: Fragment context: message 430 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0434), where the demon asks for something else.

text.reference: なにか他のものでもいただこうか
text.translation: Perhaps I shall take something else.
text.note: Fragment context: message 430 page 1 completes page 0 (dialogue_0433).

text.reference: ……もうよい{n}そなたからは期待できないようだな
text.translation: ...Enough.{n}It seems I can expect nothing of you.

text.reference: 馬鹿にしておるのか{n}やはり戦うしかないようだな{WAIT}{n}いくぞ
text.translation: Do you mock me?{n}It seems battle is our sole recourse.{WAIT}{n}Have at you!

text.reference: ふむよかろう{WAIT}{n}我は{race}{demon_name}{n}そなたと行動を共にしようではないか
text.translation: Hm. Very well.{WAIT}{n}I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}Shall we not travel together?

text.reference: ふむよかろう{n}また会うときを楽しみにしているぞ{WAIT}{n}さらばだ
text.translation: Hm. Very well.{n}I shall look forward to our next meeting.{WAIT}{n}Farewell.

text.reference: うむなかなか楽しいときをすごせたぞ{n}一緒にはゆけぬが{n}{offered_item}をやるとするか
text.translation: Mm. Our time together has been most pleasant.{n}I cannot accompany you, but{n}I shall give you {offered_item}.

text.reference: ふむ「人間」も{n}すてたものではないようだな
text.translation: Hm. It seems humans{n}are not wholly without merit.

text.reference: ふふ愚かな奴め{n}こうなるとも知らずにな
text.translation: Heh heh. Fool.{n}You never imagined it would come to this.

text.reference: これ以上そなたと話すことはない{WAIT}{n}さらばだ
text.translation: I have nothing more to discuss with you.{WAIT}{n}Farewell.

text.reference: かかってこい{n}自分に自信があるならな
text.translation: Come at me,{n}if you have confidence in yourself.

text.reference: こちらからゆかせてもらうぞ
text.translation: I shall make the first move.

text.reference: またいずれ会うこともあるだろう{n}そのときは覚悟しておけ
text.translation: We may meet again someday.{n}When we do, be prepared.

text.reference: 渡す
text.translation: Hand it over.

text.reference: またお会いできることを{n}楽しみにしておりますぞ
text.translation: I look forward{n}to meeting you again.

text.reference: 無理にでも{n}仲魔に加わらせてもらいますぞ
text.translation: I shall join you{n}whether you wish it or not.
text.note: Fragment context: message 445 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0305) with the demon's inserted race and name.

text.reference: ほんの気持ちだが{n}{offered_item}を受けていただきたい
text.translation: It is but a token,{n}but I would have you accept {offered_item}.

text.reference: とにかく{n}お手やわらかに願いたい
text.translation: In any event,{n}I ask that you treat me gently.

text.reference: どうやら我が力必要ないようだな{n}また会える日を楽しみにしておるぞ
text.translation: It appears you have no need of my strength.{n}I look forward to the day we meet again.

text.reference: 仲魔に加わらせてもらうぞ
text.translation: I shall join you.
text.note: Fragment context: message 449 page 0 joins page 1 (dialogue_0453).

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}そなたと行動を共にしよう
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I shall accompany you.
text.note: Fragment context: message 449 and message 452 page 1 complete their page-0 recruitment lines (dialogue_0452 and dialogue_0456).

text.reference: 本気にされても困るな{n}はっはっはっ
text.translation: Do not take me in earnest.{n}Ha ha ha!

text.reference: また会える日を楽しみにしておるぞ
text.translation: I look forward to meeting you again.

text.reference: それなら仲魔に加わらせてもらうぞ
text.translation: In that case, I shall join you.
text.note: Fragment context: message 452 page 0 joins page 1 (dialogue_0453).

text.reference: そなたの手にかかっておるのだぞ
text.translation: It rests in your hands.

text.reference: ん…{BEAT}なんだこれ以上{n}持てないではないか{n}残念だったな…
text.translation: Hm...?{BEAT} What is this? You can carry{n}no more.{n}A pity...

text.reference: ん…{BEAT}なんだいらぬのか{n}それは残念だな…
text.translation: Hm...?{BEAT} What is this? You have no need of it?{n}That is regrettable...

text.reference: 無念…{BEAT}{n}そなたのような者にここまで{n}追いつめられようとは…
text.translation: What bitter defeat...{BEAT}{n}To think one such as you{n}would drive me this far...

text.reference: もうよいわ我を好きにするがいい
text.translation: Enough. Do with me as you please.

text.reference: 命を助ける
text.translation: Spare its life.

text.reference: 命をうばう
text.translation: Take its life.

text.reference: おお{BEAT}かたじけない{n}そなたの恩にむくいよう
text.translation: Oh!{BEAT} You have my gratitude.{n}I shall repay this mercy.

text.reference: くっ…{BEAT}{n}そなたに助けられるとはな{n}借りは返さねばならない
text.translation: Ghh...{BEAT}{n}To think I would be spared by you.{n}I must repay this debt.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}甘い甘い{BEAT}どこまでも甘い奴よ{WAIT}{n}ここで死ぬがいい
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}Naive, naive!{BEAT} You are naive beyond measure.{WAIT}{n}Die here!

text.reference: なっ{BEAT}なにも命まで欲することは…{WAIT}{n}そなたの話に応じるゆえ{n}考え直してくれ
text.translation: Wh-{BEAT}why must you demand even my life...?{WAIT}{n}I shall hear your proposal,{n}so reconsider.

text.reference: ならばかかってこい{n}命果てるまで戦おうぞ
text.translation: Then come at me.{n}We shall fight until life itself is spent.

text.translation: Ghh...{BEAT} So this is the end...?{WAIT}{n}Nay!{BEAT} Rather than let you take my life,{n}I shall die in battle!

text.reference: おお{BEAT}デビルサマナーか{WAIT}{n}日々精進しておるようだな…{WAIT}{n}では回復してやろう
text.translation: Oh?{BEAT} A Devil Summoner?{WAIT}{n}You appear diligent in your training...{WAIT}{n}Then I shall restore you.

text.reference: おお{BEAT}デビルサマナーか{WAIT}{n}ここに{offered_item}ある{n}気にすることはない持ってゆかれよ
text.translation: Oh?{BEAT} A Devil Summoner?{WAIT}{n}I have {offered_item} here.{n}Think nothing of it. Take it with you.

text.reference: おお{BEAT}そなたデビルサマナーだな{WAIT}{n}ほう我が同胞も一緒か…{BEAT}{n}気を付けてゆかれよ
text.translation: Oh?{BEAT} You are a Devil Summoner.{WAIT}{n}Ah, one of my brethren accompanies you...{BEAT}{n}Travel with care.

text.reference: 今宵の月は美しい…
text.translation: The moon is beautiful this night...

text.reference: こんな夜は何かが起こる…
text.translation: On a night such as this, something shall occur...

text.reference: いつ起こるのだ
text.translation: When will it occur?

text.reference: どこで起こるのだ
text.translation: Where will it occur?

text.reference: 何が起こるのだ
text.translation: What will occur?

text.translation: What?{BEAT} You too wish to discover it?{WAIT}{n}Then let us go together.

text.translation: Hm... You still do not know?{WAIT}{n}It shall occur here, of course:{n}your death.

text.reference: 我には分かる{WAIT}{n}今から起こるのは…{n}そなたの死だ
text.translation: I know.{WAIT}{n}What is about to occur is...{n}your death.

text.reference: こんな夜は人を斬れと刀がうずく…
text.translation: On a night such as this, my blade aches to cut men...

text.reference: なにをする気だ
text.translation: What do you intend to do?

text.reference: おちつけ
text.translation: Calm yourself.

text.reference: やってみろ
text.translation: Try it.

text.reference: うっ…{BEAT}これは失礼{WAIT}{n}そなたなら我をいさめてくれるようだな{BEAT}{n}よかろう{BEAT}ご一緒しよう
text.translation: Ah...{BEAT} Forgive me.{WAIT}{n}It seems you could restrain me.{BEAT}{n}Very well.{BEAT} I shall accompany you.
text.note: Fragment context: messages 486, 488, and 490 page 0 continue on page 1 (dialogue_0488).

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}では早速参ろうか
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}Shall we depart at once?

text.translation: Hmph.{BEAT} You do not understand?{BEAT}{n}No matter. You soon shall.{WAIT}{n}I shall{BEAT} cut you down.

text.reference: ふっ{BEAT}落ち着いていられようか{WAIT}{n}この月夜に血しぶきはさぞ美しかろう{WAIT}{n}つべこべ言わず覚悟いたせ
text.translation: Hmph.{BEAT} How could I remain calm?{WAIT}{n}A spray of blood would look magnificent in this moonlight.{WAIT}{n}Enough prattle. Prepare yourself.

text.reference: うむ{BEAT}遠慮はせぬ{BEAT}{n}覚悟いたせ
text.translation: Mm.{BEAT} I shall not hold back.{BEAT}{n}Prepare yourself.

text.reference: どうだ月見酒といかぬか
text.translation: What say you to a cup beneath the moon?

text.reference: そうだな
text.translation: Indeed.

text.reference: 酒はちょっと…
text.translation: I am not much for drink...

text.reference: はっはっはっ{BEAT}{n}よかろうその飲みっぷり気に入った{n}一緒にゆくとするか
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{BEAT}{n}Very well. I admire the way you drink.{n}I shall accompany you.

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}では早速参ろうか

text.translation: Ha ha ha!{BEAT} I see, I see.{WAIT}{n}Drink, then! Drink!{WAIT}{n}What? Why are you asleep?

text.reference: はっはっはっ{BEAT}そうかそうか{WAIT}{n}いいぞ飲め飲め{WAIT}酔ったところで…{BEAT}{n}そなたを斬る{BEAT}覚悟いたせ
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{BEAT} I see, I see.{WAIT}{n}Drink, then! Drink!{WAIT} Now that you are drunk...{BEAT}{n}I shall cut you down.{BEAT} Prepare yourself.

text.translation: Uncultured wretch.{WAIT}{n}I shall accompany you, if only to teach you{n}the meaning of refinement.

text.reference: 無粋者め{WAIT}{n}ここで死ぬがよい
text.translation: Uncultured wretch.{WAIT}{n}Die here.

text.reference: 風流よのうそなたもそう思わぬか
text.translation: What elegance. Do you not agree?

text.reference: まあな
text.translation: I suppose.

text.reference: いつもと変わらない
text.translation: No different from usual.

text.reference: 月に関心はない
text.translation: The moon does not interest me.

text.translation: Do you not understand?{BEAT} The moon is full tonight.{WAIT}{n}I shall accompany you, if only to teach you{n}the meaning of refinement.
text.note: Fragment context: message 510 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0488) with the demon's inserted race and name.

text.translation: What? You do not understand?{n}How pitiful...{BEAT}{n}One who knows no refinement may die here.

text.reference: そなたに風流のなんたるかを{n}教えてやるためにも供をしよう
text.translation: I shall accompany you, if only{n}to teach you the meaning of refinement.
text.note: Fragment context: message 512 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0496) with the demon's inserted race and name.

text.reference: おお{BEAT}そなたは以前お会いした…
text.translation: Oh!{BEAT} You are the one I met before...

text.reference: 我が力お望みかな
text.translation: Do you desire my strength?

text.reference: 別に…
text.translation: Not particularly...

text.reference: ふむ{BEAT}よかろう{n}存分に働かせていだだきますぞ
text.translation: Hm.{BEAT} Very well.{n}I shall serve to the fullest of my ability.
text.note: Fragment context: message 518 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0496) with the demon's inserted race and name.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{BEAT}{n}いましばらくは自分の力で{n}乗り切られよ
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{BEAT}{n}For a while longer,{n}you must prevail by your own strength.

text.reference: なにもそうかたくなになることはない{BEAT}{n}我が力試されるがよい{BEAT}{n}そなたとご一緒しよう
text.translation: There is no need for such obstinacy.{BEAT}{n}Put my strength to the test.{BEAT}{n}I shall accompany you.
text.note: Fragment context: message 520 page 0 continues on page 1 (dialogue_0496) with the demon's inserted race and name.

text.reference: ならば結構{WAIT}{n}いずれ戦場で
text.translation: Then so be it.{WAIT}{n}We shall meet upon the battlefield.

text.reference: おう{BEAT}そなたは以前お会いした…{BEAT}{n}期待しておりますぞ{BEAT}{n}お達者で
text.translation: Oh!{BEAT} You are the one I met before...{BEAT}{n}I expect great things of you.{BEAT}{n}Fare well.

text.reference: うむ…{BEAT}そなたどこかで…{BEAT}{n}思い出したぞ{n}過日はよくも恥をかかせてくれたな
text.translation: Hm...{BEAT} Have we met somewhere...?{BEAT}{n}I remember now.{n}You humiliated me the other day.

text.reference: お命ちょうだいいたす{BEAT}覚悟
text.translation: I shall have your life.{BEAT} Prepare yourself.

text.reference: 命乞いする
text.translation: Beg for mercy.

text.reference: ふっ{BEAT}情けない{n}こんなくだらぬ奴にかまっていられるか{n}ふっ…
text.translation: Hmph.{BEAT} How pathetic.{n}I have no time to waste on such a wretched fool.{n}Hmph...

text.reference: いいや許せぬ{n}刀のサビにしてくれよう
text.translation: Nay. I cannot forgive you.{n}I shall make you rust upon my blade.

text.reference: ふう{BEAT}仕方ない…{WAIT}{n}殺生は好まぬ{n}どこへでもゆくがよい
text.translation: Haa...{BEAT} It cannot be helped...{WAIT}{n}I do not delight in slaughter.{n}Go wherever you please.

text.reference: ふっ{BEAT}甘いわ{n}これでもくらうがよい
text.translation: Hmph.{BEAT} How naive.{n}Take this!

text.reference: おおそなたは…{BEAT}{n}覚えておるぞ
text.translation: Oh, it is you...{BEAT}{n}I remember.

text.reference: 何か礼がしたいのだが…
text.translation: I would like to reward you somehow...

text.reference: なにもいらない
text.translation: I don't need anything.

text.reference: それはできぬ…{BEAT}{n}かわりといってはなんだが{n}{offered_item}を贈ろう
text.translation: That will not do...{BEAT}{n}Then, by way of recompense,{n}I shall give you {offered_item}.

text.reference: はっはっはっ{n}それは無理というもの
text.translation: Ha ha ha!{n}That is impossible.

text.reference: なんだ欲がないのだな…{WAIT}{n}よし{BEAT}回復してやろう
text.translation: What? You lack desire...{WAIT}{n}Very well.{BEAT} I shall restore you.

text.reference: そうか…{n}それは残念{WAIT}{n}せっかくであったのにな…
text.translation: I see...{n}That is regrettable.{WAIT}{n}And I had gone to the trouble...

text.reference: それはできぬな{BEAT}{n}はっはっはっ
text.translation: That cannot be done.{BEAT}{n}Ha ha ha!

text.reference: うむ…{BEAT}もう持てないようだな{n}はっはっはっ{n}惜しいことをしたのう
text.translation: Hm...{BEAT} It seems you can carry no more.{n}Ha ha ha!{n}What a pity.

text.reference: 待たれい{BEAT}{n}我と話すのだ
text.translation: Wait.{BEAT}{n}You shall speak with me.

text.reference: 何をしておる{BEAT}{n}そなたの目当てはこちらであろう
text.translation: What are you doing?{BEAT}{n}Surely I am the one you seek.

text.reference: 待て{BEAT}{n}我はここだぞ
text.translation: Wait!{BEAT}{n}I am here.

text.reference: 何をしておるのだ{BEAT}{n}もしや我に気付いておらぬのか
text.translation: What are you doing?{BEAT}{n}Can it be that you have not noticed me?

text.reference: くっ…不覚{WAIT}{n}今にして気づくとは{WAIT}{n}そなたの仲魔にはなれぬ
text.translation: Ghh... What a blunder.{WAIT}{n}To notice only now...{WAIT}{n}I cannot become your ally.

text.reference: くっ…不覚{WAIT}{n}今にして気づくとは{WAIT}{n}そなたの連れは我とは相入れぬ
text.translation: Ghh... What a blunder.{WAIT}{n}To notice only now...{WAIT}{n}Your companion and I are incompatible.

text.reference: くっ…不覚{WAIT}{n}今にして気づくとは{WAIT}{n}そなたまだまだ修行が足りぬようだな
text.translation: Ghh... What a blunder.{WAIT}{n}To notice only now...{WAIT}{n}It seems you still lack discipline.

text.reference: これにて失礼{WAIT}{n}{offered_item}をおいてゆこう{n}持っていくがよい
text.translation: I shall take my leave.{WAIT}{n}I will leave {offered_item} behind.{n}Take it with you.

text.reference: これにて失礼{WAIT}{n}いずれまた会おう…
text.translation: I shall take my leave.{WAIT}{n}We shall meet again someday...

text.reference: 見直したぞ{BEAT}{n}これからも修行をおこたらぬようにな
text.translation: You have changed my opinion of you.{BEAT}{n}Continue to be diligent in your training.

text.reference: 待て{WAIT}{n}…おおやはり{BEAT}我が同族も一緒か{BEAT}{n}気をつけてゆかれよ…
text.translation: Wait.{WAIT}{n}...Ah, as I thought.{BEAT} One of my kind accompanies you.{BEAT}{n}Travel with care...

text.reference: そなた… まさに 日本一の 漢よのう…
text.translation: You... truly are Japan's finest man...

text.reference: いやはや 我は 満足じゃ はっはっはっ
text.translation: Well, well. I am content. Ha ha ha!

text.reference: くっ 幻なの…か ぬおう… うりゃっ
text.translation: Gah... An illusion...? Nngh... Hiyah!

text.reference: 語りおうても 時間だけを失うのみ…
text.translation: Further parley would only waste time...

text.reference: やめよ 我が怒り すぐには おさまらぬ
text.translation: Enough. My anger will not soon abate.

text.reference: やめておくがよい 意味を持たぬことはな
text.translation: You should stop. It serves no purpose.

text.reference: 今拉の 月は 美しい…
text.translation: The moon is beautiful tonight...
